inventory_movements_delta_sign.name: inventory_movements_delta_sign

order_status_events_transition_valid.name: order_status_events_transition_valid
order_status_events_transition_valid.value:
CASE
    WHEN "order_status_events"."from_status" IS NULL THEN "order_status_events"."to_status" = 'pending_payment'
    WHEN "order_status_events"."from_status" = 'pending_payment' THEN "order_status_events"."to_status" IN ('confirmed', 'cancelled', 'expired')
    WHEN "order_status_events"."from_status" = 'confirmed' THEN "order_status_events"."to_status" = 'fulfilled'
    ELSE false END

orders_fulfillment_details_valid.name: orders_fulfillment_details_valid

products_publication_requires_commercial.name: products_publication_requires_commercial_data
products_publication_requires_commercial.value: NOT "products"."is_published" OR ("products"."price_clp" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."sale_condition" IS NOT NULL)

stock_reservations_closure_valid.name: stock_reservations_closure_valid
stock_reservations_closure_valid.value:
("stock_reservations"."status" = 'active') = ("stock_reservations"."closed_at" IS NULL)
    AND ("stock_reservations"."status" = 'consumed') = ("stock_reservations"."consumed_movement_id" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("stock_reservations"."closed_at" IS NULL OR "stock_reservations"."closed_at" >= "stock_reservations"."created_at")

user_roles_revocation_valid.name: user_roles_revocation_valid
user_roles_revocation_valid.value:
("user_roles"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "user_roles"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("user_roles"."revoked_at" >= "user_roles"."granted_at" AND "user_roles"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND ("user_roles"."role" = 'user_admin' OR "user_roles"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL))
